title: HCA Healthcare UK: Why HCA content series
summary: Fourteen short films across thirteen HCA UK facilities: hospital tours, a highlight reel, and films on research and innovation, expert teams and personalised care.
body:
For HCA Healthcare UK's Why HCA content series we filmed across thirteen facilities to show what sets its hospitals apart.

We recced each site in person, refined the shot list site by site and storyboarded every film, from camera moves to narrative order, separating must-have shots from aspirational ones. Drone flights were planned with each hospital's estates and health and safety teams, down to roof access and launch points.

The shoot ran over around three weeks, using external and internal FPV drones, gimbal cameras for tours and walk-and-talks, 360° cameras, lighting and lapel mics for interviews with clinical staff, plus stills. In post we edited, graded, designed the sound, added motion graphics and an on-screen design identity, and versioned each film for the platforms it would run on.

The series is ten hospital tour films and a highlight reel, plus films on research and innovation, expert teams and personalised care, each two to three minutes long.
